Summary.Name: DeepCORO-CTO
Summary.Description: DeepCORO-CLIP based imaging J-CTO scorer for chronic total occlusions on coronary angiography. From up to 8 videos per study it predicts the four morphological J-CTO components (blunt/flush stump, calcification at the occlusion, bending > 45°, occlusion length ≥ 20 mm) and an aggregate imaging J-CTO score clamped to [0, 4]. This is not the classic Morino J-CTO score (0–5): the fifth point for a previously failed crossing attempt is not available from imaging and is not predicted.

Mechanism.Outcome: Four J-CTO morphological component binary classifications plus imaging J-CTO score (0-4) regression
Mechanism.Output: jcto_blunt_stump, jcto_calcification, jcto_bending_gt45, jcto_occlusion_length_gt20: probabilities after sigmoid; jcto_score: predicted imaging J-CTO score clamped to [0, 4] (excludes prior-failure point)
Mechanism.Target_population: Adults with a chronic total occlusion (CTO) undergoing coronary angiography at MHI
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Coronary diagnostic angiograms (view class inferred from DICOM positioner angles)
Mechanism.Model_type: Deep Learning (MViT video encoder + view-aware multi-instance linear-probing)

Model.Purpose: Predict morphological J-CTO components and an imaging J-CTO score to support CTO PCI difficulty assessment
Model.Output: J-CTO components (blunt stump, calcification, bending > 45°, length ≥ 20 mm), imaging J-CTO score (0-4)

Uses_and_directions.General_use: Research preview for angiogram-based imaging J-CTO scoring (four morphological features only).
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: Adults with a CTO on coronary angiography. Videos are pooled per study (up to 8) and each video's angiographic view is inferred from the DICOM positioner primary/secondary angles.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Validated on MHI Labelbox-annotated data only (99 held-out studies): blunt stump AUROC 0.70 (95% CI 0.59-0.80), calcification AUROC 0.70 (95% CI 0.59-0.80), bending > 45° AUROC 0.65 (95% CI 0.50-0.79), occlusion length ≥ 20 mm AUROC 0.66 (95% CI 0.53-0.79), J-CTO score ≥ 3 AUROC 0.68 (95% CI 0.57-0.79), MAE 1.01. Not validated for clinical use outside MHI. Do not treat the predicted score as classic Morino J-CTO (0–5).

Warnings_and_limitations.Image_Quality: Requires diagnostic-quality coronary angiograms that visualise the occluded segment.
Warnings_and_limitations.Number_of_videos: Uses up to 8 videos per study, ordered by SeriesTime; extra videos are ignored. Padded slots are masked out of the pooling.
Warnings_and_limitations.View_inference: Angiographic view class is derived from DICOM PositionerPrimaryAngle/PositionerSecondaryAngle; when angles are missing a padding view embedding is used.
Warnings_and_limitations.Score_definition: Predicted jcto_score is an imaging-only morphological score in [0, 4]. Classic J-CTO also awards 1 point for a previously failed attempt; that history item is not modeled here. componentsAboveThreshold counts binary heads above 0.5 and may differ from the regression score.
Warnings_and_limitations.Confidence_Scores: Component thresholds default to 0.5 on sigmoid probability and are tracked in class_mapping.json. The J-CTO score head is a regression output clamped to [0, 4].
